test_pybind11_list_operations: test pybind11 list bindings by getting, appending, and printing Python lists from C++
test_pybind11_dict_operations: test pybind11 dict bindings by creating, modifying, and printing Python dicts from C++
test_pybind11_string_operations: test pybind11 string bindings by creating strings from bytes, objects, and format strings
test_pybind11_capsule_lifecycle: test pybind11 capsule creation and destruction with custom destructors and named capsules
test_pybind11_accessor_api: test pybind11 accessor API for reading and writing Python object attributes and items
